ItemDescription.Value:
Part of [b]ModReady[/b] — the Bannerlord dependency pack. MCM (Mod Configuration Menu v5), the in-game settings screen mods register their options with. Built for Bannerlord v1.4.6. Subscribe to all four dependencies (Harmony, UIExtenderEx, ButterLib, MCM): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198087292666/myworkshopfiles/?appid=261550]full ModReady set here[/url]. Loads through the native launcher — BLSE not required (optional, still supported). Clean-room ModReady build; credit [url=https://github.com/BUTR]BUTR[/url] for the original frameworks.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/mountandblade2bannerlord/mods/11274]Nexus — manual install, full changelog + support[/url] · [url=https://github.com/Trashpanda62/modready]GitHub — source + release zips[/url] · [url=https://www.patreon.com/Trashpanda62?utm_source=steam]Support development on Patreon[/url]
If ModReady saved you a red-screen headache, a thumbs-up helps other players find it.
